units.source_text: 西边槿姬的房室，格子窗虽已关上，但如做出不欢迎源氏公子来访的样子，也不礼貌，所以有一两处还开着。

en.t: In Lady Asagao's rooms on the west side, the lattice windows had already been closed, but it would have seemed rude to make it look as though Prince Genji's visit was unwelcome, so one or two places were still left open.

units.source_text: 此时凉月初升，照着薄薄的积雪，夜景非常美丽。

en.t: Just then, the cool moon had begun to rise, shining on the thin layer of snow, and the night scene was exceedingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起刚才这老婆婆的娇态，觉得正如俗语所说：“何物最难当？

en.t: Prince Genji recalled the flirtatious manner of the old woman just now and felt it was exactly as the common saying went: "What is hardest to endure?

units.source_text: 老太婆化妆，冬天的月亮。”

en.t: An old woman in makeup, and the moon in winter."

units.source_text: 回想她那模样，实甚可笑。

en.t: When he thought back on the way she had looked, it was truly laughable.
